question: Aman travelled from place A to place B at an average speed of 75 km/h. He travelled the first 60% of the distance in (8)/(15) of the time and rest at a constant speed of x km/h to reach B. What is the value of x ? (Nearest to an integer)
solution:
**Given:**

Average speed = 75 km/hr

**Formula used:**

Distance = Speed × time

**Calculation:**

Let the distance be y km

Time is taken by him = (y)/(75) h

60% of the distance = 60% of y = (3y)/(5)

Time is taken by him to complete the distance of y km
